I've received a slate from Ochim that I'll need to meet with the contacts at their hideout directly. I do wish they had chosen a less conspicuous name than that of the exiled one.

In any case, there is concern the supply shipments will stop due to House Dul'kehf's meddling, so I'll need to assuage their fears that the operation will continue once the chaos in Dreshdae has settled.

Unfortunately, Ochim has chosen a rather peculiar time to disappear, when he should be the liason between myself and HM. But the matter is pressing enough that I'll need to go directly and show proof I am the supplier they've been dealing with. I've talked to the crew and the Cortege is ready to go, but I should meet with Qisrani first to gather more intel on the progress of the investigation.

Hundreds of our brethren have been lost, and the number continues to rise. Today was hard. The hardest I've had to bear in my life. I almost prefer the initial chaos and questions that flooded our minds to "this." To whatever "this" is. Is loss so indescribable?
